title: Senior AI Researcher- Pre-training (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring a Senior AI Researcher to join our Pre-training team and to advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about designing inference-efficient architectures, optimizing training recipes that scale reliably, and training models on a large scale cluster (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you. Team Culture We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organisational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. About the Role As a Senior AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will own the critical technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling. Working at the high-leverage intersection of research and engineering, you will translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions - from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. We are looking for an expert who can combine rigorous experimental design with high-quality production code, directly influencing model quality, run reliability, and the efficiency of the models we ship. Your Responsibilities Recipe & Architecture Optimization: Own core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization) and design PyTorch-based architectural improvements to maximize convergence, stability, and training efficiency. Scaling Strategy & Predictability: Develop hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methodologies, using small-scale proxy experiments to reliably predict multi-thousand-GPU behavior and de-risk major training decisions. Stability, Diagnostics & Debugging: Investigate complex convergence issues (loss spikes, divergence) and resolve hard-to-reproduce distributed system failures like communication bottlenecks, race conditions, and synchronization errors. System-Model Co-Design: Partner with Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to align the model lifecycle with hardware constraints, memory bandwidth, and communication topologies. Core Qualifications You are proficient in Python and deeply familiar with PyTorch-based training workflows. You have a strong track record in machine learning research and software engineering, demonstrated through shipped models, impactful open-source contributions, or published research. You have a strong mathematical foundation and are comfortable reasoning formally about optimisation, scaling behaviour, and training dynamics. You deeply understand transformer training dynamics, optimisation, and the behaviour of large distributed training jobs. You can design rigorous experiments, reason clearly from noisy results, and translate empirical observations into robust training decisions. Hands-on experience pre-training large models (e.g., 7B+ parameters) on substantial infrastructure (e.g., 100+ GPU clusters). You apply strong software engineering practices, including writing maintainable, well-tested code and supporting reproducible experimentation workflows. You are able to implement complex model architectures efficiently and reliably and to debug complex issues across model code, training dynamics, and distributed systems. You collaborate effectively within a research and engineering team and communicate clearly about your work across Pre-training and the broader AAR/AA organization. You are able to work in Germany and collaborate regularly on site in Heidelberg as part of the Pre-training team. Preferred Qualifications Large-Scale Training: Hands-on experience training LLMs or multimodal models on large GPU clusters using distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan). Predictive Scaling: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer, or methods for predicting large-scale training behavior from smaller proxy runs. Stability & Performance: Experience profiling distributed jobs and diagnosing training anomalies like loss spikes, numerical instability, or optimizer pathologies. Advanced Architectures: Exposure to sparse training approaches (e.g., Mixture-of-Experts) and an understanding of their routing and systems trade-offs. Track Record of Impact: Demonstrated research excellence through top-tier publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR), impactful open-source contributions, or significant shipped technical work. Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale. title: Chief Science Officer
description: Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾 Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time Who we are Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL. Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles. Why this role, why now Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. The Real-World Learning Loop is your system Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise: In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning. Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find. Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe. Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely. Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time. Responsibilities Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments. Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop. Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next. Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot. Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard. Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm. Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join. Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation. Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML. Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships. raw.title: Chief Science Officer
raw.description:
Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” (The Real-World Learning Loop, Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise:

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely.

Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time.

Responsibilities

  • Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments.

  • Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop.

  • Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next.

  • Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot.

  • Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard.

  • Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm.

  • Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join.

  • Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation.

  • Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML.

  • Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships.

  • Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction.

Not in scope, by design

  • Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next.

  • A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer.

  • Product roadmap and pricing.

What makes this role hard

  • Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open.

  • Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system.

  • A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses.

  • By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet.

  • By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning.

What you bring

  • You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it.

  • Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first.

  • Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join.

  • You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work.

  • You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it.

  • PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record.

Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Tell us about a model you took from a paper to a robot that ran for weeks without you. What broke first?

  2. If you had our deployment data tomorrow, which bet would you make first, and what would you stop?

  3. How do you decide what to publish and what to keep?

What we offer

  • Robots in live production that learn every day, and the data that comes with them.

  • A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with meaningful equity.

  • Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in.

  • Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support.

How we hire

Conversations with both founders, a research deep dive with the team, and a working session on a real problem from our deployments. We move fast.

Deine Aufgaben: Projekt- und Auftragsmanagement: Du steuerst unsere Projekte aus kaufmännischer Sicht, von der ersten Bestellung bis zur finalen Lieferung. Einkauf und Materialwirtschaft: Du unterstützt die Beschaffung von Komponenten und pflegst enge Beziehungen zu unseren Lieferanten. Bestandsmanagement: Du behältst unsere Lagerbestände im Blick und stellst sicher, dass alle Komponenten zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind. title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
description: Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. Job Summary We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer. Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up. You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership. Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery. If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base. Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent. Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance. Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it. Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results. Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding. Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost. Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact. Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches. Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have: Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics. Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve . Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance. Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology. Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter. Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes . What We’re Looking For Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level. A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams. Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery. raw.title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
raw.description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine

About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

  • Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

  • Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

  • Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

  • Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

  • Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

  • Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics.

  • Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve.

  • Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance.

  • Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology.

  • Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter.

  • Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery.

  • Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research.

  • Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

You’ll report to our Head of Accounting & Tax, working alongside an experienced team where you’ll have real ownership from day one and the opportunity to expand into new areas as we grow.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Own Procure-to-Pay & Expense Operations

  • Manage the end-to-end P2P process in Ramp, from invoice intake and coding to approval follow-ups and biweekly AP payments, ensuring strong controls.

Deliver Accurate Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Own assigned OPEX, card spend, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Partner with FP&A to ensure accurate GL and cost-center coding, timely financial information, and a reliable month-end close.

  • Maintain clear accounting records, support audit requests, and document processes to ensure continuity and effective controls.

Build an AI-Native Accounting Function

  • Use n8n, AI tools, and modern accounting platforms to identify opportunities for automation and continuously improve workflows.

  • Validate AI-generated outputs, prioritize human review where risks are highest, and maintain reliable evidence for stakeholders, regulators, and auditors.

Must-haves

  • 📊 Systems & spreadsheet skills: You're confident using spreadsheets and accounting systems, with strong attention to coding accuracy, data quality, and financial controls.

  • 🎯 Ownership & reliability: You take responsibility for daily operations, follow through on commitments, and proactively identify ways to improve how things work.

  • 💬 Clear communication: You communicate effectively in English, collaborate well across teams, and enjoy helping colleagues solve operational challenges.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Modern finance tools: You've worked with AI-native ERPs, Ramp or similar P2P platforms, Q2C tools, or workflow automation platforms like n8n.

  • 🌍 International accounting: You have experience working across multiple entities, ideally in a global business with an expanding international footprint.

  • 💰 SaaS & revenue accounting: You're familiar with SaaS business models, multi-currency accounting, AR, or revenue recognition.

  • 🔍 Audit & qualifications: You bring an audit background or relevant accounting qualifications that strengthen your accounting expertise.

  • 🇩🇪 German language skills: You can communicate in German, although this is not required for the role.

At n8n, you won't just process transactions — you'll help rethink how accounting works at an automation company. You'll own meaningful parts of our accounting operations, build AI-powered improvements you can see in action, and help shape a scalable finance function at one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team where autonomy, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning are encouraged. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll have the opportunity to deepen your GL, P2P, and close expertise while gradually expanding into AR and revenue accounting as we grow.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of AI-native accounting.

title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps . Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of. Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes. Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps ! As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You’ll Do As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox. In this role, you can expect to: Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks. Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality. Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base. Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence. Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services. Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity. Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services. Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront). Experience building mapping and geospatial related products. Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub. Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs. Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented. An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings. A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion. raw.title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
raw.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps. Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

  • Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

  • Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

  • Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence.

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services.

  • Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity.

  • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services.

  • Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront).

  • Experience building mapping and geospatial related products.

  • Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub.

  • Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs.

  • Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented.

  • An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings.

  • A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion.

  • A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

  • High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production.

Nice to Have Traits for This Role

  • Proficiency in C++

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>You will be the technical authority for RF hardware behind Dedrone's airspace security products — the RF detection sensors that find and classify drones, and the countermeasure systems that defeat them. You own the hard RF problems end to end: wideband receive chains, high-power transmit chains, and their physical realization on board. You do not carry direct reports, but you technically lead a group of RF hardware engineers and antenna designers — you set the standards they design to, review their work, and grow their capability.&nbsp;This is a hands-on role. You will spend real time in simulation, on the bench, and in the chamber.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director RF Engineering</p> <ul> <li>Own RF front-end architecture from VHF through SHF: link budgets, frequency planning, spurious and intermodulation analysis, sensitivity and dynamic-range trade-offs.</li> <li>Design and characterize mixers, high-power amplifiers, filters, and switching networks against demanding linearity, efficiency, and thermal targets.</li> <li>Drive board-level simulation (EM, circuit, and co-simulation) and take designs through multi-layer RF PCB layout, stack-up definition, and fabrication release.</li> <li>Lead bring-up, characterization, and design-for-test; close the loop between simulated and measured performance.</li> <li>Set and enforce RF design standards, review checklists, and documentation practice across the group.</li> <li>Mentor RF HW engineers and antenna designers; raise the technical bar through design reviews rather than rework.</li> <li>Partner with DSP, software, mechanical, and systems engineering, and with regulatory/compliance on CE, FCC, and MIL-STD qualification.</li> <li>Advise leadership on technology direction, build-vs-buy, and technical risk.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in RF hardware design, with a track record of products shipped to volume.</li> <li>Deep expertise across VHF, UHF, and SHF — not just one band.</li> <li>Demonstrated design ownership of mixers and high-power amplifiers above 10 W.</li> <li>Strong command of RF simulation tooling — EM and circuit solvers (e.g. ADS, AWR, HFSS, CST) — and the judgment to know when simulation is telling you the truth.</li> <li>Multi-layer RF PCB design: controlled impedance, material selection, grounding, isolation, thermal management.</li> <li>Fluent with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power measurement; comfortable debugging from first principles.</li> <li>Proven technical leadership of a design group — setting direction and standards, mentoring, running rigorous design reviews.</li> <li>Degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Antenna design and integration — element and array design, platform effects, radiation-pattern measurement.</li> <li>Direction-finding techniques (amplitude/phase comparison, interferometry, TDOA, AoA estimation).</li> <li>Beamforming across approaches: analog, digital, and hybrid; phased arrays and adaptive/null-steering methods.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with SDR platforms.</li> <li>Experience developing and qualifying products for regulated markets — CE, FCC, and/or MIL-STD.</li> <li>Working knowledge of DSP concepts sufficient to trade functionality between analog and digital domains.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? title: Senior Growth Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Als Senior Growth Manager bei LIQID entwickelst du Kampagnenkonzepte, die messbares Wachstum entlang des gesamten Funnels erzeugen – von der Akquisition affluenter Privatkunden bis zu ihrer Aktivierung im Bestand. Du verantwortest Konzept, Kanalplan und Zielerreichung für definierte Themen wie Produkt-Launches, Kanalerschließungen oder Reaktivierungsmaßnahmen. Die operative Umsetzung koordinierst du mit den umsetzenden Einheiten wie Marketing, Investments oder Vertrieb. Damit trägst du direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei. Was machst du dabei konkret? Kampagnenkonzepte: Du entwickelst End-to-End-Konzepte für definierte Wachstumsinitiativen. Dabei verantwortest du die Zielerreichung des Konzepts und korrigierst den Kurs, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen. Das Budget für die Kampagne hast du dabei stets im Blick. Briefings und Kanalverständnis: Du erstellst strukturierte Briefings für Performance Marketing, CRM und Content, abgeleitet aus Kampagnenzielen und Zielgruppe. Du verstehst die Mechanik der relevanten Growth-Kanäle so weit, dass du Spezialist:innen präzise briefen und ihre Umsetzung fachlich bewerten kannst. Funnel-Erfahrung: Du erkennst und optimierst Wachstumshebel entlang des gesamten Sales Funnels. Das gelingt dir durch dein tiefes Verständnis der Conversion Rates und Mechaniken im Funnel sowie der übergeordneten Customer Journey. Experimente und Funnel-Hebel: Du identifizierst Kampagnenansätze für bislang ungenutzte Zielgruppensegmente und Lücken im Funnel. Hypothesen zu Kanalmix und Messaging überführst du in konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen. Die Erkenntnisse teilst du strukturiert im Team, damit sie in die nächsten Kampagnen einfließen. Erfolgsmessung und Dokumentation: Du steuerst deine Kampagnen über KPIs wie Net New Money, CAC und Effektivität. Entscheidungen, Annahmen und Learnings dokumentierst du systematisch, sodass sie für das Team nachvollziehbar und wiederverwendbar sind. Deine Auswertungen bereitest du so auf, dass sie als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen. Cross-funktionale Koordination: Du koordinierst die Umsetzung über alle beitragenden Teams hinweg – ohne formale Weisungsbefugnis, aber mit klaren Timelines. Du hältst Stakeholder auf einem Stand, verfolgst Meilensteine und eskalierst Blocker, bevor sie die Umsetzung gefährden. Auf C‑Level argumentierst du dabei evidenzbasiert. Das bringst du mit Background Du verfügst über mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem dynamischen Umfeld, idealerweise in FinTech, Strategieberatung, Banking oder einem Unternehmen mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten. Du hast digitale Akquisitions-Funnels und Multi-Channel-Kampagnen über Paid, Owned und Earned konzipiert und gesteuert. Du bringst Erfahrung und eine persönliche Affinität zum Thema Geldanlage mit. Skills & Fähigkeiten Du formulierst Briefings, die Spezialist:innen der Fachbereiche schnell umsetzen können, und bewertest deren Ergebnisse fachlich fundiert. Du denkst datenbasiert: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie und übersetzt Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Maßnahmen. Dabei bist du analytisch exzellent und detailverliebt. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit relevanten Tools wie HubSpot, Salesforce, Braze und Analytics-Plattformen. Du koordinierst abteilungsübergreifend, auch ohne formale Weisungsbefugnis, und hältst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen. Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, gegenüber Fachteams ebenso wie auf C‑Level. Mindset Du ziehst deine Motivation aus dem Erfolg deiner Kampagnen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Zielerreichung. Du gestaltest Strukturen und Prozesse in einer Transformationsphase aktiv mit und gehst Themen proaktiv an. Du gibst und nimmst fachliches Feedback und argumentierst auf C‑Level diplomatisch und durchsetzungsstark. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung! Das bieten wir dir Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500 €. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall. Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Case Study: Du zeigst uns anhand eines realistischen Szenarios, wie du eine Wachstumskampagne konzipierst, steuerst und auswertest. Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Investments und Vertrieb. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, tiefgehende Einblicke in das Management eines der innovativsten Scale-Ups im Bereich Financial Services zu gewinnen und den Arbeitsalltag unseres CEOs unmittelbar mitzugestalten. Aufgrund der Nähe zum Senior Management ist eine hohe Präsenz im Berliner Büro Voraussetzung.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Kalender- & Terminmanagement: Du steuerst und priorisierst den Kalender unseres CEOs, koordinierst Termine über verschiedene Stakeholder hinweg und organisierst nach Bedarf Reisen sowie deren Vor- und Nachbereitung.

  • Meeting-Vorbereitung & -Nachbereitung: Du bereitest Meetings des Management Teams organisatorisch vor, erstellst Agenden und Unterlagen, hältst Ergebnisse und To-dos fest und sorgst für ein konsequentes Follow-up.

  • Externe Kommunikation: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für externe Partner & Investoren und bereitest für den CEO die quartärlichen Board Meetings koordinativ sowie inhaltlich vor und nach.

  • Interne Kommunikation & Koordination: Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO and den Teams, sorgst für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss und stellst sicher, dass Anfragen zeitnah und zuverlässig bearbeitet werden.

  • Interne Organisation: Du übernimmst die organisatorische & inhaltliche Vorbereitung von All-Hands, Team-Events, Offsites und Formaten rund um das CEO Office und behältst dabei stets den Überblick über parallele Themen.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Executive Assistant, im Assistenz- oder Office-Management, idealerweise im direkten Umfeld von Senior Management in einem dynamischen Umfeld wie einem Scale-Up, einer Beratung oder einem vergleichbaren Kontext.

  • Organisationstalent: Ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Prioritäten, exzellentes Zeitmanagement und die Fähigkeit, auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick zu behalten.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Diskretion & Verlässlichkeit: Ein hohes Maß an Vertraulichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Verbindlichkeit im Umgang mit sensiblen Themen.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, eine proaktive Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld schnell pragmatische Lösungen zu finden.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

 

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. title: Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will contribute to the definition and development of key aircraft mechanical systems, including the Environmental Control System, landing gear, ice protection, interiors and other mechanical systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft. Your Day-to-Day: Define and derive system-level requirements for mechanical aircraft systems based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations. Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces. Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase. Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines. Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems. Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements. Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities. Your Profile: Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems. Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration. Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear. Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification. Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus. Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment. Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight. Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems. Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme. Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for one or more mechanical systems on a CS-23 aircraft programme. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation. We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments. Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us. Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days. Become a part of our success with virtual stock options. Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket. Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability. Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security. Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft. Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects. Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports). raw.title: Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders)
raw.description:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will contribute to the definition and development of key aircraft mechanical systems, including the Environmental Control System, landing gear, ice protection, interiors and other mechanical systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for mechanical aircraft systems based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems.

  • Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme.

  • Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for one or more mechanical systems on a CS-23 aircraft programme.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Fußball Amateur- & Profisport
description: Mach Vereinsgeschichten sichtbar Du fühlst Dich auf dem Sportplatz wohl, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und hast Ideen für Videos, die man sich bis zum Ende anschaut? Du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera und kannst Deine Inhalte eigenständig drehen und schneiden? Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport sowie für Unternehmen und besondere Themenwelten. Bei uns bekommen Vereinsmitglieder ihren eigenen Sticker, Fans sammeln ihre Mannschaft und am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht. Dahinter stecken Geschichten, die wir auf Social Media bisher viel zu selten erzählen. Unsere Kanäle und unsere Reichweite möchten wir deshalb gezielt ausbauen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der diesen Bereich mit eigenen Ideen und praktischer Erfahrung voranbringt. Deine Aufgaben Content entwickeln und produzieren: Du setzt Ideen für Reels, TikToks und Stories um. Vom Konzept über den Dreh bis zum Schnitt und zur Veröffentlichung begleitest Du Deine Inhalte selbst. Vor der Kamera stehen: Du stellst unsere Sammelaktionen vor, führst kurze Interviews und gibst Einblicke in den Alltag bei stickerfive. Vereine begleiten: Du besuchst Fotoshootings, Verkaufsstarts und Tauschbörsen. Dabei fängst Du die Stimmung ein und kommst mit den Menschen vor Ort ins Gespräch. Unsere Kanäle betreuen: Du entwickelst einen Redaktionsplan, veröffentlichst regelmäßig und kümmerst Dich um Kommentare und Nachrichten. Reichweite und Community aufbauen: Du entwickelst wiederkehrende Formate und Inhalte, die Menschen gerne anschauen, teilen und kommentieren. Passende Trends greifst Du auf und übersetzt sie in Ideen für stickerfive. Ergebnisse auswerten: Du schaust Dir an, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Dabei interessieren Dich beispielsweise Wiedergabedauer, geteilte Beiträge und die Entwicklung unserer Community. Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Du planst Termine und kümmerst Dich rechtzeitig um die Informationen und Materialien, die Du benötigst. Was du mitbringst Du hast bereits selbst Social-Media-Inhalte produziert und kannst uns konkrete Beispiele zeigen. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein oder Deinen eigenen Kanal, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast und was Du daraus gelernt hast. Außerdem wünschen wir uns: Interesse am Sport, besonders am Amateur- und Vereinsleben. Vielleicht bist Du selbst im Verein aktiv oder begleitest schon eine Mannschaft mit der Kamera. Freude daran, vor der Kamera zu sprechen und auch auf fremde Menschen offen zuzugehen. Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera und einem Schnittprogramm wie CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve. Ein Gespür für gute Einstiege, verständliche Geschichten und das passende Tempo eines Videos. Gute deutsche Ausdrucksfähigkeit, sowohl beim Sprechen als auch beim Schreiben. Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. Du bringst Ideen ein, organisierst deren Umsetzung und sprichst offene Fragen oder Hindernisse frühzeitig an. Bereitschaft zu Drehs bei unseren Partnervereinen, in der Regel am Wochenende. Eine bestimmte Ausbildung oder ein Studium setzen wir nicht voraus. Deine Arbeitsproben und Deine Fähigkeiten zählen. Eine große eigene Followerschaft brauchst Du ebenfalls nicht. Erfahrung mit bezahlter Werbung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast bereits mit Meta Ads oder TikTok Ads gearbeitet und Kampagnen zur Gewinnung neuer Interessenten betreut? Dann kannst Du diese Erfahrung bei uns einbringen und je nach Kenntnisstand auch Kampagnen übernehmen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Content und dem Aufbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle. Dein Gestaltungsspielraum Unser Social-Media-Auftritt (Facebook & Instagram) ist ziemlich mau. Auf TikTok sind wir noch nicht aktiv. Du kannst deshalb von Beginn an mitprägen, wie stickerfive auftritt. Vielleicht begleitest Du eine Mannschaft, die zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Album sieht. Vielleicht entwickelst Du ein Interviewformat am Spielfeldrand oder zeigst, wie aus einem Mannschaftsfoto ein Sticker wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der solche Ideen mitbringt und sie umsetzt. Gemeinsam legen wir Ziele und Prioritäten fest. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und arbeitest eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die unsere Sammelprojekte betreuen. Das erwartet Dich bei uns Geschichten direkt aus dem Sport: Du lernst Amateurvereine kennen und erhältst Einblicke in unsere Projekte mit dem Profisport. Kreativer Freiraum: Du entwickelst eigene Formate und prägst den Auftritt von stickerfive mit. Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Du arbeitest direkt mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb zusammen. Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Sportplatz: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in Gräfelfing bei München. Wie oft Du wirklich am Ende vor Ort in Gräfelfing bei München oder im Homeoffice bist, kommt auf Deinen Wohnort an. Für Drehs bist Du auch bei unseren Partnervereinen unterwegs. Ausstattung und Flexibilität: Du erhältst ein Firmenhandy und bei Bedarf auch einen Firmenlaptop. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten stimmen wir passend zu Drehs und Teamterminen ab. Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stadionbesuch oder Wiesn, auch außerhalb unserer Projekte unternehmen wir etwas zusammen. Extras im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte gehören ebenfalls dazu. Zeig uns, was Du machst Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über Deinen bisherigen Weg sowie Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos, die Du selbst konzipiert, gedreht oder geschnitten hast. Bei gemeinsamen Projekten schreib bitte kurz dazu, welche Aufgaben Du übernommen hast. Mindestens eines der Beispiele sollte Dich vor der Kamera zeigen. Falls Du dazu noch nichts Passendes hast, reicht auch ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo mit dem Smartphone. Erzähl uns außerdem, welchen Bezug Du zum Sport hast, wann Du anfangen könntest und welchen Stundenumfang und welches Gehalt Du Dir vorstellst. Bewirb Dich direkt hier über die Plattform oder kontaktiere uns über unsere Kanäle Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Produkt- & Kundenmanager (m/w/d) – Software für die Energiewirtschaft
description: Die envago GmbH aus Leipzig entwickelt Software für Netz- und Messstellenbetreiber. Mit envago.EAST digitalisieren wir die Zählerablesung, inklusive KI-gestützter Zählerstandserkennung und Ableseportal für Endkunden. envago.WEST bildet Geräteprozesse wie den Zählerwechsel ab. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen der Energiewirtschaft, die sich auf funktionierende Prozesse verlassen müssen. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass unsere Software genau das tut, was der Kunde im Alltag braucht. Deine Rolle Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserer Software. Du kennst unsere Produkte so gut wie ein Anwender und prüfst neue Funktionen, bevor sie zum Kunden gehen. Genau dieses Produktwissen macht dich im Gespräch mit Bestands- und Neukunden glaubwürdig. Deine Aufgaben Produkt & Test - Du testest neue Funktionen und Releases fachlich aus Sicht unserer Kunden und nimmst sie ab. - Du erstellst strukturierte Testszenarien und Testfälle und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse. - Du beschreibst Fehler und Verbesserungsvorschläge so, dass unsere Entwicklung damit arbeiten kann. - Du bringst Anforderungen und Feedback unserer Kunden in die Weiterentwicklung der Produkte ein. Kunden & Vertrieb - Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden als feste Ansprechperson: von Fragen zur Anwendung bis zur Weiterentwicklung der Zusammenarbeit. - Du gewinnst neue Kunden. Dazu gehören Produktpräsentationen, Angebote und Verhandlungen. - Du stellst envago auf Fachmessen und bei Kundenterminen vor (bis zu ca. 12 Reisetage im Jahr). Dein Profil - Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, im Vertrieb oder im Produktumfeld, idealerweise mit B2B-Software. - Du musst nicht programmieren können, hast aber ein gutes technisches Verständnis. Du willst verstehen, wie Software funktioniert und wie Kunden sie nutzen. - Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert. Fehler, die anderen entgehen, fallen dir auf. - Du trittst sicher und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden auf und verhandelst gern. - Kenntnisse der Energiewirtschaft (Netzbetrieb, Messstellenbetrieb, Zählerwesen) sind von Vorteil. - Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher. - Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B. Was wir bieten - Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zur Entwicklung - Direkten Einfluss darauf, wie sich unsere Produkte weiterentwickeln - Eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle zwischen Produkt, Kunden und Messe Interesse? Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit! Es ist eine aufregende Zeit bei SoSafe! Wir erweitern kontinuierlich unsere Kundenbasis, und das Customer Programs Team ist dafür verantwortlich, die Reise unserer Mid-Market-Kunden von der Onboarding-Phase bis zur Verlängerung zu begleiten – durch Ad-hoc-Anrufe, Webinare und 1-to-Many-Interaktionen. In dieser Rolle wirst du verschiedene Engagement-Modelle für unsere Kundenbasis entwickeln, um die Produktadaption sicherzustellen und skalierbare Customer-Success-Strategien zu implementieren, die außergewöhnlichen geschäftlichen Mehrwert und herausragende Nutzererlebnisse bieten. Wir suchen eine/n analytische/n und kundenorientierte/n Teamplayer/in, der/die in der Lage ist, eine neue Strategie umzusetzen, nach dem Prinzip "Test-and-Learn" zu arbeiten und messbare Ergebnisse zu liefern. Du wirst skalierbare Programme für unsere Kunden entwickeln, verwalten und umsetzen. Diese Programme können u. a. Diese Programme wirst du nutzen, um dein eigenes Kundenportfolio zu unterstützen, das sich auf alle SoSafe SMB- und Low-Touch-Kunden konzentriert. Erstellung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von 1:Many-Programmen und Initiativen zur Umsetzung von skalierbaren Kundenbindungsstrategien (z. B. E-Mail-Kampagnen, Office Hours, gezielte Kundenberatungen). Enge Zusammenarbeit mit CSMs, AEs sowie den Produkt- und Marketing-Teams, um 1:Many-Erlebnisse innerhalb des zugewiesenen Kundenstamms zu fördern. Aufbau von Prozessen zur Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit auf skalierbarer Ebene; Nutzung interner Dashboards und Kennzahlen, um Risiken oder Chancen innerhalb Ihres Portfolios (500 bis 1.000 Accounts) zu identifizieren und darauf zu reagieren. Agieren als „Operational Champion“ bei SoSafe und Vorbildfunktion bei der Sicherstellung der Datenhygiene in unseren internen CS-Tools, Salesforce etc. Was dich auszeichnet: Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten Rolle (Inside Sales, Customer Success, BDR oder Product Marketing). Erfahrung mit gängigen SaaS-Tech-Stacks (Salesforce, Highspot, Planhat, KI Tools etc.). Diplomatisches Geschick, Taktgefühl und Souveränität unter Druck, insbesondere bei der Bearbeitung von Kundenproblemen und Eskalationen. Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern. Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events zur Präsentation unseres innovativen Produkts und zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts. Anpassungsfähig und in der Lage, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld flexibel zu managen. Offen für Feedback und Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im hybriden Modell – mit Anwesenheitstagen im Büro sowie Remote-Tagen. Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot), Prospecting-Software und LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Fließende Deutsch und Englisch- Kenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt. Was wir bieten*: Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte, sowie Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits mit Urban Sports Club Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro *Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln. Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo.
