raw.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who can execute fast, iterate with creative and funnel inputs, and scale what works. You’ll inherit high-performing campaigns and work directly with our CMO to double down on growth.

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

  • Take the lead on one or two paid acquisition channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.), with potential to expand scope based on performance

  • Contribute to building scalable acquisition funnels, from execution to iteration, with aggressive growth targets in mind

  • Run high-velocity testing loops (creatives, audiences, placements) to improve CAC and LTV

Performance Analysis and Strategy

  • Monitor performance daily using tools like Voluum, GA4, and internal dashboards

  • Drive decision-making through deep analysis of CPA, ROAS, retention, and cohort behavior

  • Build and maintain internal reporting frameworks that guide strategic shifts and tactical moves

Creative & Funnel Optimization

  • Own the creative briefing process: define hooks, formats, and angles based on performance patterns

  • Collaborate closely with the content and product teams to launch and iterate on high-converting landing pages

  • Implement systems to reduce creative fatigue and increase speed of testing

Partnership Management & Media Strategy

  • Build strong relationships with traffic sources and negotiate premium placements and custom deals

  • Explore new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools) and build internal evaluation criteria

  • Stay ahead of ecosystem changes (platform rules, algorithm shifts) and adapt strategy accordingly

Automation & Scaling Systems

  • Identify opportunities to streamline acquisition processes through automation and internal tools

  • Create SOPs, playbooks, and experiment pipelines for scaling campaigns efficiently

Challenges You’ll Tackle

  • Scale existing campaigns to 3x+ budget while maintaining CAC/ROAS goals

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

Must-Haves

  • 4–10+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and funnel conversion

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Past exposure to subscription models and CAC/LTV frameworks

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth)

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

⏱️ Obsessive about speed, performance and iteration

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

  • Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

  • Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

  • Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

  • Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

  • Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

  • Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

  • Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

  • Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

  • Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

  • Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

  • Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

  • Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

  • Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

  • Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Required Skills</strong></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p><em>Degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or comparable practical experience</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Proficiency in Python and C++ for robotics and hardware interfacing</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Experience with ROS2, including deployment on physical systems</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Hands-on experience with several hardware protocols such as I2C, SPI, CAN, Serial, or Ethernet-based sensor communication</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Experience integrating cameras or other sensors on embedded Linux platforms, ideally NVIDIA Jetson</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Solid computer vision fundamentals: camera models, distortion, projection geometry, OpenCV</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Good understanding of coordinate frames, transformations, and time synchronization in distributed systems — practical calibration experience is a strong plus</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Comfortable with hardware diagnostic tools (multimeter, oscilloscope) as well as modern software workflows (Git, CI, Docker)</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Practical and structured; willingness to travel regularly for field campaigns and to work outdoors in various conditions</em></p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Nice-To-Have</strong></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p><em>UAV or mobile robot experience; PX4/ArduPilot and MAVLink basics</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Photogrammetry + 3D Reconstruction</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Low-level driver development or customization on embedded Linux</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>GStreamer hardware-accelerated pipelines, JetPack/L4T, CUDA/TensorRT</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>MIPI/CSI-2 camera bring-up, ISP tuning, or Linux kernel/device tree exposure</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Calibration tooling such as Kalibr; lidar and point cloud processing (PCL, Open3D)</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Experience with detection/tracking models and modern CV pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX)</em></p> </li> <li style="font-style: italic;"> <p><em>Experience with simulation (Gazebo, Isaac Sim) or synthetic data generation</em></p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your <strong>CV in English</strong>. Pipeline & Sourcing

  • Manage relationships with external agencies and vendors where used, including scoping engagements and monitoring fee exposure

Data & Process

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate and requisition data in Ashby, supporting reliable reporting on pipeline health, conversion rates, and time-to-hire

  • Strong command of structured interviewing and competency-based assessment, not just informal impression-based screening

  • Comfortable partnering directly with hiring managers and pushing back when a process or bar needs to change

  • Fluent in an ATS (Ashby or equivalent), with the discipline to keep data clean and reporting-ready

Additional Skills / Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for robotics, hardware, or deep-tech companies

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

👉 EU: While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

  • This is a full-time, remote position.
  • Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.


About the Role

Lokalise's People team is responsible for building and sustaining the high-performance, distributed workforce that our business depends on. Our HRBPs own talent strategy across their business areas. This role owns the operational infrastructure that makes that strategy real.

As Senior HR Operations Lead, you will be responsible for designing, building, and continuously improving the systems, processes, and ecosystem relationships that determine the quality of the employee experience and, ultimately, the performance of our people. This role reports to the CHRO.

 

What You Will Do 

  • Build and own the HR operating model that enables Lokalise's talent strategy — designing the systems, processes, and experiences that drive a high-performance organization
  • Design the HR experiences — onboarding, performance, development, exits — that continuously increase the quality of talent at Lokalise
  • Turn people data into operational intelligence that gives HRBPs and business leaders what they need to make proactive, high-quality talent decisions
  • Design and own the HR calendar as a deliberate series of interventions that drive performance, compensation, and development outcomes across the business
  • Build and own the HR technology and vendor ecosystem — including EOR partnerships across multiple countries — to scale with Lokalise's growth
  • Integrate compliance across a distributed, multi-country workforce in a way that creates no friction for the business

 

What You Must Have

  • Experience operating as a senior individual contributor with full ownership of an HR operations domain
  • Experience partnering with a mature HRBP and stakeholder ecosystem
  • Experience making HR operational decisions based on business impact and commercial context
  • Experience using people data to inform decisions and operational solutions design
  • Demonstrated passion for building business first HR infrastructure — not simply maintaining existing processes or policy policing
  • Experience in HR operations at senior level in a distributed technology or SaaS environment
  • Experience managing EOR relationships and multi-country employment complexity
  • Experience owning vendor relationships across HRIS, payroll, and benefits

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.
🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.
🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.
🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.
🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.
📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.
🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.
🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.
🤝 Great culture: remote but close-knit, daily lived values, constant push for bigger, better, winning.

title: Human Resource Director, Europe & Canada
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">&nbsp;</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. With a global team of over 3,000 professionals, we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to grow. Work alongside industry-certified experts, access continuous training, and enjoy competitive benefits. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>The <strong>Human Resources Director, Europe &amp; Canada</strong> is responsible for leading the HR strategy, operations, and employee experience across Canada, the United Kingdom, Belgium, and Romania. The role will lead regional HR resources while collaborating closely with global HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and business leadership.</p> <p>This Human Resources Director, Europe &amp; Canada will have 3 direct reports and serves approximately 250 employees in the region.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>PRIMARY DUTIES:</strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic HR Leadership &amp; Business Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the senior HR leader for Canada, the UK, Belgium, and Romania, providing strategic HR direction across the region. identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and adapt global HR initiatives to country-specific needs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>HR Operations &amp; Regional Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead regional HR operations, ensuring consistent, scalable, and employee-focused HR practices across the employee lifecycle.</li> <li>Lead and develop the regional HR team, including HR Managers in the UK and Romania and an HR Coordinator in Romania.</li> <li>Partner with global HR to standardize and continuously improve processes while addressing local requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Employee Relations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead employee relations matters across the region, including disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, redundancies, and dismissals.</li> <li>Coach managers to address employee relations and performance issues consistently, with appropriate documentation and escalation.</li> <li>Partner with General Counsel and external counsel on employment-related claims and proactively reduce employment risk.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Talent Acquisition &amp; Onboarding</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own regional recruitment and onboarding of top talent in partnership with offshore recruiters and hiring managers.</li> <li>Build talent pipelines for critical roles and ensure hiring practices and documentation meet local requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Talent talent reviews with leaders to identify critical roles, high-potential employees, and capability gaps.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Payroll &amp; HR Administration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee regional restructurings, redundancies, and terminations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Organizational Effectiveness &amp; Workforce Planning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide guidance on organizational structure, spans of control, and workforce planning to support growth and scalability.</li> <li>Support integrations, restructurings, acquisitions, and related change and communication strategies within the region.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant progressive HR leadership experience, including experience at the HR Director, Head of HR, Senior HR Business Partner, or comparable level.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience supporting employees and leaders across multiple countries or jurisdictions.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of employment practices and employee relations within the UK and broader European environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing complex employee relations matters, including investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, redundancies, and dismissals.</li> <li>Experience partnering with senior business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, restructuring, and talent strategy.</li> <li>Experience leading and developing HR professionals.</li> <li>Strong understanding of recruitment, onboarding, performance management, succession planning and employee development.</li> <li>Excellent communication, influencing, consultation, and stakeholder-management skills.</li> <li>Ability to operate effectively within a global organization and collaborate across countries, cultures, and time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct HR experience supporting employees in Canada, the United Kingdom, Belgium, and/or Romania.</li> <li>Experience within a global professional services, technology services, managed services, or similarly complex organization.</li> <li>Experience supporting acquisitions, integrations, restructurings, or other <p><strong>LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Business Partnership: </strong>Connects workforce and organizational decisions directly to business priorities and outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Acumen: </strong>Understands how talent, organizational structure, workforce costs, and leadership capability affect business performance.</li> <li><strong>Employment Risk Judgment: </strong>Balances employee experience, business objectives, consistency, and employment risk when advising leaders.</li> <li><strong>Influence &amp; Credibility: </strong>Builds trusted relationships with senior executives, managers, employees, and global functional partners.</li> <li><strong>Change Leadership: </strong>Effectively leads organizations and employees through transformation, restructuring, integration, and growth.</li> <li><strong>Talent Mindset: </strong>Proactively develops internal talent and strengthens leadership pipelines and <li><strong>Sound Judgment &amp; Discretion: </strong>Demonstrates maturity and confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and legal matters.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>LANGUAGE SKILLS: </strong>Ability to read, understand, and interpret job-related documents, instructions, policies, and communications in English. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, with employees, customers, vendors, and other business partners, as applicable to the position. Fluent English is required. Fluent or professional-level French language capability is preferred.</p> <p><strong>REQUIRED EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS: </strong>Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Preferred: CIPD or an equivalent internationally recognized HR credential.<strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>PHYSICAL DEMANDS:</strong> Regular use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment, including repetitive motions such as typing, scrolling, and mouse use. Ability to communicate effectively and understand verbal communication in person, by telephone, and through video conferencing or other remote communication tools. Ability to view and read information on computer screens and printed materials, including the ability to adjust focus. The position requires prolonged periods of computer use and viewing a computer screen.</p> <p><strong>WORK ENVIRONMENT: </strong>Remote</p> <p><strong>EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: </strong>This position generally operates during normal business hours; however, specific start and end times may vary based on business needs, workload, and job responsibilities. title: Senior Software Engineer – C# / .NET
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>About Threecolts</strong></h4> <p>Threecolts is a software suite built for consumer brands, helping them recover revenue, operate more efficiently and grow across major retailers and marketplaces.<br>Our largest business, Margin Pro, helps brands recover money owed to them by retailers and marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart and Target by managing disputes on their behalf. Alongside this, we’re building and scaling newer products, including AI Operator and Retail 365, while continuing to grow our portfolio of subscription products across our customer base.</p> <h4><strong>Who We Are&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>We’re a global team of 340 people across 33 teams, having grown through 24 acquisitions. We operate with a flat structure, giving people real ownership and the ability to move quickly. AI is embedded in how we work across the business, helping us increase speed, improve quality and operate at scale.</p></div><p><strong>🔥 Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>You’ll take ownership of features across Inventory Lab’s C# and .NET-based systems, delivering them from initial design through to production. You’ll design, develop, and maintain clean, scalable backend services, APIs, and application components using C# and the .NET ecosystem.</p> <p>You’ll work with modern .NET technologies, including ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core, to build and maintain reliable, high-performance web applications and services. You’ll focus on writing maintainable, well-tested code that supports the product’s evolving requirements.</p> <p>You’ll develop and maintain front-end features using Vue.js and TypeScript, building responsive, intuitive, and maintainable user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs. You’ll take ownership of full-stack features end to end, from designing backend services and data models to implementing front-end components, managing application state, and ensuring a consistent user experience. You’ll collaborate with Product, QA, and DevOps to deliver reliable, performant features across the entire application stack.</p> <p>You’ll operate independently within a defined scope, making sound technical decisions and balancing delivery speed with long-term quality. You’ll actively improve existing systems, debug production issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes.</p> <p>You’ll contribute to technical discussions, help evolve architecture within your domain, and raise engineering standards through thoughtful code reviews. Collaboration is key: you’ll work closely with Product, QA, and DevOps to deliver features and improvements that provide meaningful value to Inventory Lab customers.</p> <p><strong>😊 About You</strong></p> <ul> <li>6–8+ years of professional software engineering experience.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in <strong>C#</strong> and experience building production-grade applications.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the <strong>.NET platform</strong>, including its runtime, libraries, and application development ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience developing web applications and backend services using <strong>ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core</strong>.</li> <li>Experience developing modern web applications using Vue.js or React, including component-based architecture and reusable components.</li> <li>Experience building responsive, accessible user interfaces and integrating front-end applications with REST APIs, and maintaining backend services.</li> <li>Solid understanding of system design, application architecture, and scalable software development patterns.</li> <li>Experience working with SQL databases, relational data models, and query optimization.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure: AWS or Azure.</li> <li>Experience debugging production systems, investigating root causes, and resolving issues independently.</li> <li>Comfortable working with Git, code reviews, automated testing, and collaborative development workflows.</li> <li>Ability to work effectively within an existing codebase and improve code quality without over-engineering.</li> </ul> <p><strong>💼 What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>You have a strong ownership mindset and consistently deliver high-quality work. You make pragmatic technical decisions, understanding when to prioritize speed and when to invest in scalability, reliability, and maintainability.</p> <p>You understand the practical application of C# and the .NET ecosystem, choosing appropriate frameworks and patterns to build reliable software. You’re comfortable working with existing systems, identifying opportunities for improvement, and delivering solutions that balance immediate business needs with long-term technical quality.</p> <p>You thrive in a product-led environment and care about the customer impact of what you build. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams, and look for ways to improve both the product and engineering processes.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll support Inventory Lab, a product used by e-commerce sellers to manage inventory, listings, accounting, and operational workflows. The work will suit someone who enjoys solving practical product problems, improving system reliability, and building software that supports real customer use cases.</p> <p><br><strong>⛳️ Compensation, Perks &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Salary: £ 110,000 per year</li> <li value="1">25 days PTO</li> <li value="1">Healthcare &amp; Pension benefits&nbsp;</li> <li value="1">Opportunity to join company-wide offsites</li> <li value="2">Regular rate reviews and bonus opportunities</li> <li value="3">Fully remote/hybrid working</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate - Materials
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Company Description:</strong> Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.</p> <p>As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.</p> <p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p></p> <h2>Strategy Associate, Materials &amp; Circular Economy</h2> <p><strong>Location: London preferred. Amsterdam also possible</strong></p> <p>Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to join our Materials &amp; Circular Economy team. This role is suited to someone who combines strong strategic thinking with the intellectual curiosity to tackle complex sustainability challenges.</p> <p>You will work on some of the most important questions facing companies, governments and wider society as they shift towards more circular and sustainable models. Projects can range from shaping corporate strategy and identifying new business opportunities to assessing value chains, developing policy recommendations and designing system-level interventions.</p> <p>We are looking for someone who can bring the core toolkit and pace of a strong strategy consultant: structured problem-solving, analytical rigour, clear communication and sound judgement. Strategy consulting experience is one route to demonstrating this. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.</p> <p>You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Structure complex problems:</strong> break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Generate insights:</strong> conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Shape recommendations:</strong> translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Develop client materials:</strong> produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engage with clients:</strong> work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Contribute to project direction:</strong> help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build trusted relationships:</strong> work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You will be part of Systemiq's Materials &amp; Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.</p> <p>Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.</p> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <h4>Strategy and analytical capability</h4> <p>We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Experience and background</h4> <p>You will typically bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.</p> <h4>Sector interest and understanding</h4> <p>You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials &amp; Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.</p> </li> <li> <p>A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Location</h3> <p>London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="description__body"></div> <p><strong data-start="578" data-end="603">Diversity &amp; Inclusion</strong><br data-start="603" data-end="606">At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.</p> <p>Click&nbsp;<a href="https://www.systemiq.earth/privacy-policy/">here</a> to view our Data Policy.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Restaurants run on a stack of tools that rarely talk to each other: one for delivery, another for online orders, another for reservations, another for loyalty, and a till that knows nothing about any of them. The same guest can look like three different customers across three different systems.</p> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's platform for fixing that. It connects marketplace ordering, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, guest management, marketing and point of sale around one shared view of the guest, so every product gets smarter as the others are used. DoorDash launched DashOS publicly at Dash Forward in September 2026, and from 2027 more than 80,000 restaurants on leading POS and middleware partners.</p> <p>DashOS Engineering brings together engineers from across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt into one global organisation, led from London. Our teams cover reservations and guest CRM, digital ordering and omnichannel loyalty, POS and self-order kiosks, AI-powered marketing and Voice AI, and the shared data and integration platforms that connect them. Each team owns its own roadmap. The shared mission is making them work as one system.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for a backend-focused Software Engineer to build the high-performance, highly available services that restaurants depend on every day, from booking a table on a Friday night to recognising a regular the moment they order. You'll work closely with other engineers, product managers and designers, and because DashOS is newly launched, you'll help shape how its products connect rather than inheriting decisions someone else already made.</p> <h2><strong>You're excited about this opportunity because you will...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, test, deploy and improve backend services for customer-facing features used by restaurants and their guests in markets around the world.</li> <li>Own features end to end, from technical design through to launch and ongoing support, including taking part in an on-call rotation to keep systems reliable.</li> <li>Work on hard problems in data, latency and scale: unifying guest identity across channels, real-time availability search across thousands of venues, and integrations with the systems restaurants already run.</li> <li>Build on DoorDash's global platform, so the features you ship can reach restaurants across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt markets rather than being rebuilt for each one.</li> <li>Work in a modern engineering environment with frequent daily releases, feature flags and AI coding agents used across code review, deployment and debugging.</li> <li>Partner with engineers, product managers and designers across London and other DashOS locations to decide what to build and how.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're excited about you because...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>You've built and operated backend services or web applications in production, with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and system design.</li> <li>You're fluent in at least one modern backend language (we mostly use Python), and you're happy to pick up new languages and tools as the platform evolves.</li> <li>You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership of technical solutions from first design to production.</li> <li>You use AI coding tools as part of how you work, or you're keen to, and you're comfortable reviewing and taking responsibility for what they produce.</li> <li>You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve problems that don't have an obvious answer yet.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Tech you'll work with</strong></h2> <p>Our services are built mainly in Python, with performance-critical systems in Rust, running on Google Cloud and DoorDash's global platform. AI coding agents are part of how we design, review and ship code, so we care more about how you solve problems than about which languages you've used before. You won't need to know every part of the stack on day one.</p> <h2><strong>Where and how we work</strong></h2> <p>This role is based in our London office at The River Building, on a hybrid pattern of 3 days a week in the office.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.</p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="135" data-end="148">About the job</h3> <p data-start="150" data-end="229">Build the framework support that helps AI developers unlock Graphcore hardware.</p> <p data-start="231" data-end="458">You will help Graphcore accelerators work seamlessly with state-of-the-art ML frameworks, including Triton and PyTorch. Reporting to a Team Lead in Frameworks, you will design, implement, optimise and support critical software.</p> <p data-start="460" data-end="660">Your work will shape how researchers and engineers use Graphcore hardware for demanding machine learning workloads. You will improve performance, quality and usability across a complex software stack.</p> <p data-start="662" data-end="874">You will join our Triton team, delivering new features, reviewing code, writing technical documentation and working with upstream communities. You will also help coordinate open-ended technical work across teams.</p> <p data-start="876" data-end="1046">This role offers deep technical ownership and visible impact as the ML software landscape evolves. You will keep learning and may contribute across other framework teams.</p> <h3 data-start="1048" data-end="1068">The team and culture</h3> <p data-start="1070" data-end="1261">The Frameworks team connects Graphcore hardware with the tools ML engineers and researchers rely on. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3 data-start="3650" data-end="3676">Join the Team at Graphcore</h3> <p data-start="3678" data-end="3957">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="3959" data-end="4241">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p data-start="4243" data-end="4565">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p data-start="4567" data-end="4710" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you want to shape the frameworks developers use to push AI compute forward, we’d love to hear from you. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>You’ll join a technology community of product-focused and data-led product and platform engineers working at scale. We have a diverse ecosystem, spanning TypeScript on AWS, Go on GCP and Scala, we index on product-minded problem solving over language purity.</p> <p>As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from design through to production, and you’ll build AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.</p> <p>From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and access to the systems you need through MCP. Our tools and conventions evolve quickly, and you’ll directly impact how we build from here.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own a slice of the product end to end: </strong>shape the problem with product and design, build the interface and the services behind it, ship it, and run it in production.</li> <li><strong>Work across the stack over time</strong>: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.</li> <li><strong>Build with AI coding agents as your default</strong>: Break work down so agents can execute, direct them, and review their output as carefully as you’d review a colleague’s pull request. You’ll also maintain the tests and safeguards that let agent written code merge safely.</li> <li><strong>Stay close to the people who use what you build: </strong>directly or through our forward-deployed engineers: a supplier’s operations team, a customer plugging in a car at night. Instrument what you ship so you can see how it’s used, and turn what you learn into shipped changes.</li> <li><strong>Make good work the default: </strong>shape the codebase, conventions and automated checks so that agents and new teammates produce the right thing without anyone catching it in review.</li> <li><strong>Mentor the team around you:</strong> Coach and mentor your peers and help improve how we work and evolve as a team.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our top engineers and value deeply, but we don't expect everyone to tick every single box. If you're excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience shipping production software:</strong> You have a depth of experience in either a front-end or back-end of a modern stack, and potentially an openness to stretch across both as you navigate our diverse ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>AI coding tools:</strong> You build with tools like Cursor or Claude Code, can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way and review AI output as rigorously as a colleague’s pull request.</li> <li><strong>Able to navigate a complex, high-stakes domain:</strong> You keep complex energy logic legible across microservices, knowing exactly when to use sync vs async to prevent cascading failures.</li> <li><strong>Cloud and operational ownership:</strong> You're comfortable deploying on major cloud platforms using shared tooling. You fully own your software in production, which includes participating in an out-of-hours on-call rota.</li> <li><strong>Strong product sense.</strong> You ask the “why” before building, and you can describe a time when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.</li> <li><strong>Clear written communication.</strong> You write specs, pull request descriptions and post-mortems with enough clarity and context that either a human teammate or an AI agent can immediately act on them.</li> <li><strong>A multiplier for your team:</strong> You mentor peers and proactively shape how the team works; introducing conventions, checks or shared context that makes everyone else’s output consistently better.</li> </ul> <p><strong>It would be great if you have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building tooling around coding agents, such as MCP servers, skills or CI checks</li> <li>Experience in energy, or another real-time or regulated field</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values</strong></p> <p>Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Play to win:</strong> Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.</li> <li><strong>Solve the real problem:</strong> Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Build trust every day:</strong> Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.</li> <li><strong>Own the outcome:</strong> Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.</li> <li><strong>Go further together: </strong>Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Perks</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Time off and family:</strong> 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period</li> <li><strong>Health and security:</strong> Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests</li> <li><strong>Pay and flexibility:</strong> Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% of salary to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work</li> <li><strong>Growth and setup:</strong> Personal learning budget, home office budget</li> <li><strong>Climate:</strong> Access to Furthr, our climate action app</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Come as you are</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Find out more on our<a href="https://www.kaluza.com/careers/"> careers page</a> and<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/"> LinkedIn</a>. title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description: Let’s transform banking forever ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate. That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure. But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward. What you can expect: As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you’ll play an important role in creating a seamless and welcoming experience for candidates and keeping our Talent Acquisition operations running smoothly. You’ll coordinate interviews, maintain accurate information in Ashby and support the production of regular Talent Acquisition reporting. You’ll also work with colleagues across Talent to support supplier administration and help organise our monthly induction for new joiners. This role is suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to a busy environment, cares about getting the details right and wants every interaction with ClearBank to leave a positive impression. Your role includes: Complete the day-to-day administration of Ashby, maintaining accurate and complete candidate, vacancy and recruitment information to support reliable reporting and compliant hiring processes. Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, managing candidate and interviewer communication and availability to create a timely, organised and professional experience. Welcome and support candidates attending interviews at the ClearBank office, particularly senior candidates, creating a positive and professional first impression. Monitor recruitment activity and data quality in Ashby, identifying missing, inaccurate or outdated information and working with recruiters to resolve issues promptly. Produce accurate weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards and insights, providing clear visibility of recruitment activity and data to the Talent Acquisition Lead. Support wider Talent operations, including supplier onboarding and offboarding for the Head of Talent and the organisation of monthly new-joiner induction with the Talent Development Manager. Identify opportunities to improve Talent Acquisition coordination and administration, suggesting practical ways to make processes simpler, clearer and more effective. What does success in this role look like: Ashby contains accurate, complete and dependable recruitment information that the Talent Acquisition team can confidently use for reporting and decision-making. Candidates experience organised, timely and thoughtful communication throughout interview coordination and when visiting the ClearBank office. Interviews are coordinated effectively across stakeholders and time zones, with scheduling problems identified and resolved promptly. Weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards are produced accurately and consistently, giving the Talent Acquisition Lead clear visibility of recruitment activity. Supplier administration and monthly induction coordination are organised and reliable, with the relevant stakeholders kept informed. What you’ll bring: To excel in this role, you’ll also need: Previous experience in a Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination or similar role, with hands-on experience supporting interview scheduling, candidate administration and day-to-day recruitment processes. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple interviews, activities and competing priorities. Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with recruitment systems, schedules, reports and confidential information. Confidence communicating with candidates and colleagues at different levels of seniority. The ability to use digital systems effectively and learn new technology and processes quickly. A methodical approach to maintaining accurate records and identifying missing or inconsistent information. The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks, follow agreed processes and ask for support when needed. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams. Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team. Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes. Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! Our commitment to you as a candidate: We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time. We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully. We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon! Equal Opportunities ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. The legal bit By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. raw.title: Dental Field Trainer - Birmingham
raw.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a highly consultative Field Trainer in Birmingham to lead impactful, in-person training that accelerates early clinical success with Dandy’s digital dentistry solutions. This role is field-based, with up to 80% travel, and is focused on helping dental practices adopt intraoral scanning and digital workflows with confidence.

You’ll serve as a trusted clinical advisor to dentists, practice managers, and operational leaders—helping teams adopt new technology, digital workflows, improve clinical performance, and accelerate early success. This role combines clinical training expertise with operational execution and post-training insight to deliver measurable value at the intersection of training, technology, and practice growth. Success in this role comes from your ability to earn clinical trust and turn that trust into action — helping practices move from curiosity to confidence.

What You’ll Do:

Training Delivery & Clinical Coaching

  • Lead high-touch, in-person trainings to support dentists and staff in adopting intraoral scanning and digital workflows.

  • Coach teams based on live observation, reinforcing best practices and adapting in real time to meet the practice’s goals and maturity level.

  • Take ownership of each practice’s success, driving early case submission by removing blockers, reinforcing clinical urgency, and building confidence during and immediately after training.

Clinical Advisory & Post-Training Analysis

  • Partner with clinicians and practice leaders to reinforce scanning habits and support early adoption.

  • Monitor outcomes in the first 30 days and surface targeted coaching opportunities to accelerate success.

  • Share field insights to inform scalable resources, improve onboarding, and strengthen future trainings.

Practice Readiness & Operational Alignment

  • Assess readiness across clinical workflows, team structure, and equipment to proactively surface blockers or risks.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure the right resources, messaging, and tools are in place before training day.

  • Customize training strategies based on practice size, complexity, and clinical goals.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Clinical Training Experience: 3+ years of experience delivering clinical training in digital dentistry or dental technology, with strong familiarity with intraoral scanning and digital workflows.

  • Clinical Advisor: Skilled at earning confidence from clinicians and staff by connecting clinical value to real-world outcomes

  • Travel Readiness: Willingness and enthusiasm to travel up to 80% to deliver in-practice training and support.

  • Proximity to Travel Hubs: Located near a major airport or transport hub.

  • Leadership Presence: Comfortable partnering with senior leaders, clinicians, and staff across roles to influence behavior and drive adoption.

  • In-Person Agility: Comfortable operating independently in the field, adjusting plans in real-time based on practice dynamics and needs.

  • Strong Communicator: Excellent presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to adjust tone and approach based on audience—whether working with hygienists or C-suite stakeholders.

Customer-Centric Mindset: Passion for helping practices succeed, with a solutions-oriented approach to onboarding, training, and adoption.

title: Europe Strategy & Operations Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.</p> <p>We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p class="p1">We're looking for a strategic, analytical leader to drive growth and performance across our European and International business. In this role you'll personally own a high-impact portfolio of initiatives, doing the deep analytical work and driving execution yourself, while setting strategic direction and coaching a small team of individual contributors.</p> <p class="p1">You’ll connect the dots across product and go-to-market, using analytics, customer insights, and opportunity sizing to decide where we invest and how we execute. You’ll partner closely with Product, Operations, Revenue, and Data Science, and become a trusted advisor to senior leadership across the business.</p> <p class="p1">This is a player-coach role for someone who wants to shape strategy and also roll up their sleeves to deliver results. This role is based in London.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Drive OKR attainment for the International team, owning strategy and execution for our Europe Top 8 priorities</li> <li class="li1">Lead and develop a team of Strategy &amp; Operations ICs through coaching, prioritization, and vision setting</li> <li class="li1">Personally own key initiatives in Europe: identify opportunities that move company metrics, align cross-functional teams, remove roadblocks, and lead execution end to end</li> <li class="li1">Prioritize GTM and Product initiatives based on impact, strategic importance, and complexity, and partner with Data Science to build and refine the models that support those decisions</li> <li class="li1">Proactively identify opportunities that grow retailer lifetime value (LTV)</li> <li class="li1">Drive forecasting, performance monitoring, and metric decomps, and surface the insights that matter most to leadership</li> <li class="li1">Build effective, scalable operational processes and close operational gaps</li> <li class="li1">Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Product, Operations, Revenue, and leadership</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">8+ years of experience in consulting, finance (investment banking or private equity), or analytical business operations roles</li> <li class="li1">Experience managing and developing people</li> <li class="li1">Some experience partnering with GTM and Product teams</li> <li class="li1">You are an exceptional creative problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and structure a path to an answer.</li> <li class="li1">You are analytical and comfortable with data. You have strong analytical thinking and SQL knowledge, or the willingness to learn it quickly.</li> <li class="li1">You have strong product and business intuition. You can place insights in the context of broader business goals.</li> <li class="li1">You are a scrappy, resourceful executor. When something needs to get done, you remove roadblocks and find a way to make it happen.</li> <li class="li1">You are highly collaborative and influence effectively through others</li> <li class="li1">You are a clear, structured communicator, both written and verbal</li> <li class="li1">You have a strong work ethic and an ownership mindset, and you stay calm and perform under pressure and tight deadlines</li> <li class="li1">You embrace the adventure and do whatever it takes to ensure success</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range</strong></p> <p>London: the pay range for this role is £141,000 to £193,500 per year.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).</em> Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.&nbsp;<br></span></em></p> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move fast:</strong> You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.</li> <li><strong>Equipped to scale:</strong> We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.</li> <li><strong>Best in class:</strong> Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.</li> <li><strong>Real rewards.</strong> Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Belonging:</strong> We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.</li> </ul> <p>Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our <a href="https://blog.faire.com/">blog</a>.</p> <p></p> <p>Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.</p> <p>Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.&nbsp; To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSczpI9me7nYKhunSC6AlagHKv75LHqfi-Qi2TP_3dpin0Uc9Q/viewform">Accommodation Request Form</a> (<a href="https://bit.ly/faire-form)">https://bit.ly/faire-form)</a></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Privacy</strong></p> <p>For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s <a class="c-link" href="https://www.faire.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.faire.com/privacy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Perform by Marcus Evans is our performance-improvement consultancy. We don’t sell off-the-shelf training. Job Summary

We are hiring a Senior Sales Executives to sell Perform to senior leaders at large organisations: Heads of HR, L&D, Talent and Transformation, and the business executives who sponsor their programmes.
